instruction: kcadm.sh config credentials --server http://localhost:8080 --realm master --user admin --password admin
output: Logged in to master realm on http://localhost:8080

instruction: kcadm.sh create users -r myapi -s username=apiuser -s enabled=true
output: Created user apiuser in realm myapi

instruction: kcadm.sh create clients -r myapi -s clientId=gateway-client -s publicClient=false -s secret=mysecret
output: Created client gateway-client in realm myapi
Created group api-admins in realm myapi
Added role admin to user apiuser
Created role api-consumer in realm myapi

instruction: kcadm.sh create identity-provider -r myapi -s alias=github -s providerId=github -s enabled=true -s config.authorizationUrl=https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize
output: Created identity provider github in realm myapi

instruction: kcadm.sh create client-scopes -r myapi -s name=api-scope -s protocol=openid-connect
output: Created client scope api-scope in realm myapi
